$BTC That is a good example of how we often see the start of new months & quarters.

Lots of volatility, choppy price action and liquidity sweeps.

Usually price starts to form some sort of direction by day 5-10 which holds for the ~2 weeks following.

In this case I think $84K (Friday low) and $87K (Friday high) are good levels to watch for a break to see where this wants to go next.

quote.text:
The end and start of the month and quarter are usually choppy and love sweeping liquidity (on both sides).

Not the place where you want to position yourself directionally straight away usually.

Usually best to let it play out some days and then reassess.
